ratios.quote: We were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement as of December 31, 2025 (the net leverage ratio was 0.56 to 1.00, compared to a maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25 to 1.00 on a quarterly basis covering the trailing four consecutive fiscal quarters for each fiscal quarter).

parsed.notes: Net leverage is measured quarterly on a trailing four-quarter basis. The 3.25x maximum can step up to 3.75x for a period after a material acquisition. No borrowings were outstanding under the $1.5B revolver at 2025-12-31. The commitment fee (5.5 bps) is set by credit rating and KPIs, not by the ratio.
